render_note: Fold-out page 34 carries a 1533 x 906 pixel JPEG over 1104 x 652 points (100 dpi); the 100 dpi render is one render pixel per scan pixel. Walls are drawn brick by brick, so faces are irregular; picks follow straight runs of brick faces traced with scripts-H probes.

north.evidence: Fig. 4, MITATHAL 1968: PLAN MTL 2 (PDF p. 34, fold-out), lower middle: a line with an elongated loop at its upper end, a short cross-bar and the letter N beside the loop; no true or magnetic wording on the plan. The loop-ended needle may follow a magnetic-needle convention, but nothing states it.
north.survey_year_evidence: Plan title MITATHAL 1968; the excavation took place between January and April 1968 (report p. 3).

scale.evidence: Metre scale at bottom: ticks 0 (x 697.5), 1 (x 832.5) and 2 (x 964.5); the trench pegs I-X along the top are about 133 px apart, consistent with 1 m.
